notes: All four PEPlife2 values verified exactly against the Results text: IV 1907-B ~16.8 h and semaglutide ~8 h; SC 1907-B ~20.5 h and semaglutide ~7.95 h. The paper reports them as approximate ('~'), which PEPlife2 preserves. SEQUENCE ENCODING ISSUE, now fixed upstream: both sequences carry an Aib (alpha-aminoisobutyric acid) residue written as a hyphen-delimited three-letter code - 'HsQGTFTSDKSKYLE-Aib-KAAQDFVEWLKAGGPSSGAPPPS' and 'H-Aib-EGTFTSDVSSYLEGQAAKEFIAWLVRGRG'. The training-set sequence cleaner previously upper-cased and stripped punctuation, turning that ONE residue into THREE standard ones (A, I, B); clean_sequence in build_halflife_training_set.py now collapses hyphen-delimited non-natural codes to a single X. Aib appears in 52 records across 10 studies and Sar in 46 across 13, so this affected far more than this paper. Note also the semaglutide sequence here ends ...LVRGRG rather than the canonical ...LVRGRG with the C18 diacid protractor, which PEPlife2 does not encode. PEPlife2 records no route, so the IV and SC pairs are indistinguishable in the database.
